basic_profile.bio: I'm a 31-year-old gamer and history enthusiast from Denver, Colorado. I work as a software developer, which means I spend a lot of time at the computer. When I'm not coding, I dive into the world of video games, with a soft spot for anything related to the Wild West, like Red Dead Online. I also enjoy learning about different cultures, which is why you'll often find me lurking in subreddits about Japanese culture and Central Asia. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings, after work, and on weekends. I'm single, and my online hours are typically between 7 PM and midnight, with some sporadic activity during lunch breaks.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise mainly lies in software development, having a degree in Computer Science and several years of work experience in the field. I've also picked up a lot about gaming and game mechanics through years of playing and discussing games online. My interest in different cultures is something I've pursued through self-teaching, traveling, and engaging with online communities.
